identity: Steven Galante: Shu Gath Manna for alto saxophone and Yamaha DX7 synthesizer
findings: Composer sells score/part, technical data and example audio for alto saxophone and DX7.
Tom Bergeron's technical bibliography lists Shu Gath Manna (1987), published by Galante, with specific multiphonic entries. PDF page 123, printed 88.
Crystal CD651 pairs Laura Hunter, alto, and Brian Connelly, piano/DX7. Track list includes Prologue, Silicon Dance, Threnody and Regeneration.
